thesis: The bear carries the near-term directional case on observed sequential margin and cash weakening plus a fresh unquantified policy overhang and high-volume breakdown. This is a medium-confidence sell/avoid-new-entry research view; it does not assert a specific liability or permanent impairment from a proposal.
strongest_counterexample: The company still reports positive earnings and FCF, debt below the year-ago observation and operating margin above that weak base, while the proposal may change before finalization.
invalidation_conditions: Reconsider toward neutral or buy after two consecutive reports show sequential operating-margin and FCF improvement, with verified medical-cost and reserve data supporting that improvement.
Reconsider the regulatory component if the final rule removes the proposed retrospective exposure or verified company disclosure quantifies it as immaterial.
evidence_gaps: Medical-cost, reserve and normalized earnings evidence.
Final form and company-specific impact of the regulatory proposal.
Cause and durability of the sequential margin deterioration.
decisive_factors: Operating margin weakened across both supplied 2026 sequential comparisons.
FCF below the preceding and year-ago observations.
The latest high-volume decline broke the short and intermediate averages.
